name: Reward Forcing
model_version: Reward Forcing rewardforcing.pt (chunk-wise AR, 4-step rewarded DMD, EMA attention sink, no CFG) on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B; code JaydenLyh/Reward-Forcing@4317f5a0d29d

weights.repo: JaydenLu666/Reward-Forcing-T2V-1.3B@fc7e9400 (rewardforcing.pt) + Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (umT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.1 VAE, DiT config)

license.weights: Apache-2.0 (code repository licence; the model card states none)

notes: Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 832x480 at 16 fps, 3-latent (12-frame) causal blocks generated live with the upstream reward_forcing.yaml settings (4 DMD steps 1000/750/500/250, shift 5.0; local attention 9 latents with a 3-latent EMA sink, window-relative RoPE, so long sessions use the model's own streaming mechanism). It has no prompt-switch mechanism: the block prompt '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' is re-encoded and the cross-attention cache reset at the next block; camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input.
